name: codex-onboarding-skill
description: Create a low-friction Codex Starter Pack for new agent users.

interface.shortDescription: Install, then run $onboarding in a new Codex session.
interface.longDescription: After installation, open a new Codex session and send: Use $onboarding to generate a Codex Starter Pack for my work. This creates AGENTS.md, profile, routes, lessons, starter workflows, and artifact-task rules so Codex can understand a user or project faster.
defaultPrompt: Use $onboarding to generate a Codex Starter Pack for my work.
